mappings.note: Identify the samas type of the compound 'गृहप्रवेश'. This is a व्याकरण item filed under the कारतूस chapter, so it belongs to the grammar competency, not to C-H2.3-LO-1 -- nothing about the play's content, characters or narrative is being tested.
Samas identification for the reduplicative 'साफ़-साफ़' (अव्ययीभाव). Grammar competency C-H2.2 rather than C-H2.3-LO-2: it probes word formation, not the playwright's मंतव्य or भाषा-शैली.
Samas identification for 'त्रिकोण' (a द्विगु, i.e. a तत्पुरुष subtype). Structural word analysis, so C-H2.2 and not the prose-comprehension outcome C-H2.3-LO-1.
Samas identification for 'मृगलोचन'. Again a व्याकरणिक संरचना item, mapped to C-H2.2; C-H2.3-LO-1/LO-2 would wrongly claim the कारतूस text is being comprehended.
